title: SAFra: life-cycle carbon calculator for Alcohol-to-Jet SAF from Brazilian ethanol
description: SAFra is a browser-based screening tool that estimates the well-to-wake carbon intensity of Alcohol-to-Jet (ATJ) sustainable aviation fuel from Brazilian sugarcane and corn ethanol. It combines state-level agricultural inventories (Pereira et al. 2025), stand-alone and integrated cane-corn mill configurations, five hydrogen supply routes and three land-use change accounting methods, and benchmarks results against CORSIA default values, US corn pathways and published ATJ life cycle assessments. Screening use only; not a substitute for certified CORSIA, RED III or RenovaBio calculations.
